about_the_game:
This is an action-adventure game where a magical girl embarks on a journey through a fantasy world. Take control of the protagonist and dash through eight diverse stages. At the end of each stage, a powerful boss awaits the player.

[Diverse and Exciting Stages]

Each stage features a unique theme, offering distinct challenges and requiring different strategies. Soar through the skies on a giant bird, experience the eerie atmosphere of a ghost ship, run across floating clouds in thrilling aerial action, or embark on an adventure aboard a minecart. The game is packed with exciting surprises to keep players engaged.

[Boss Rush Mode Added]

As the game's climax, a Boss Rush mode will test the player's skills. To reach the ending, players must defeat every boss that stands in their way. Challenge yourself and prove your mastery in this final trial!

[Fusion of Graphic Styles]

The game’s backgrounds feature beautifully hand-drawn, high-resolution artwork that brings to life enchanting forests, ancient castles, and more. Meanwhile, characters, items, and enemies are designed in charming pixel art, blending the nostalgic appeal of retro games with modern visuals.

[Story]

The protagonist, YUMI, is a young magician with a distinctive blue hat and cape. One day, while playing in the forest as usual, she suddenly falls into a mysterious hole. When she wakes up, she finds herself in a strange fantasy world. Determined to return to her own world, YUMI sets off on an adventurous journey through the unknown.

[Items & Fruits]

Collecting floating fruits is a key gameplay element. These fruits can increase the number of remaining lives or even grant special abilities, such as instantly teleporting to the end of the stage in certain situations.

[Rewards for Clearing Stages]

After completing each stage, players are treated to stunning high-resolution artwork, offering a moment of relaxation and reward for their efforts. This sense of accomplishment fuels motivation to tackle the next stage.
